description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CandidateHiringAPI, which is part of the Recruitment API in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests various API endpoints such as getOne, update, delete, and their validation rules, but many methods are expected to throw 'not implemented' exceptions. The class sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies API behavior within the test suite.

classes.name: CandidateHiringAPITest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for testing the CandidateHiringAPI's endpoints and validation rules within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM.
